description: Prepare a difficult personal or professional conversation: clarify the goal and boundary, map perspectives and likely reactions, choose safe timing/channel, draft an opening and key lines, rehearse responses, and plan exit/escalation. Turkish triggers: zor konuşmaya hazırlan, bunu nasıl söyleyeyim, sınır koymak, aile/partner/iş arkadaşıyla konuşmak, prova yap. Use crisis or abuse safety routing when harm or coercion is present; use message-writer for a finished sendable message.
